DEARBORN COUNTY PROPERTY TAXPAYERS
The 2025 payable 2026 Property Taxes will be due Monday, May 11, 2026, and Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Please remember bills are only mailed out in the Spring . Tax bills will be mailed out by April 15th. If you did not receive your bill, please visit www.lowtaxinfo.com to print a new copy, or call our office at (812)-537-8811 for one to be emailed to you. We are not responsible for any penalty you may incur due to not receiving a tax bill .
You may pay your taxes in one of the following ways:
• In person at the Treasurer's Office Monday- Friday from 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.
• By mail postmarked by May 11, 2026, and November 10, 2026. Metered mail must be received with 5 business days of the due date in order to be considered on time. Mail must be addressed correctly to be considered on time. Please enclose a self-addressed stamped envelope if you would like your receipt returned.
The mailing address is:
Dearborn County Treasurer
165 Mary Street
Lawrenceburg, IN 47025
• After office hours by using our GREEN DROP-BOX outside the Main Entrance doors of the County Administration Building by 11:59 pm May 11, 2026, and November 10, 2026. Please e nclose a self-addressed stamped envelope if you would like your receipt returned. Please, DO NOT LEAVE CASH!!
• By credit card or e-check by visiting dearborn-indiana-tax.com.
Note: credit/debit card payments will be assessed a 2.25% convenience fee (minimum of $2.95). E-checks are a flat $.65 fee. Electronic payments are timestamped upon being submitted. Payments submitted after 11:59pm on the due date, will be considered late.
• By phone by calling (812)-438-7250. Please have your bills ready as you will need your Parcel Numbers. This is an automated service. Please listen carefully to the prompts. Credit/Debit card payments will be assessed a 2.25% convenience fee (minimum of $2.95). E-checks are a flat $.65 fee. Electronic payments are timestamped upon being submitted. Payments submitted after 11:59 pm on the due date, will be considered late. WE ARE NOT BONDED TO TAKE PAYMENTS BY PHONE IN OFFICE.
If you have any questions, please contact our office by calling 812-537-8811, or email: hhatfield@dearborncounty.in.gov as soon as possible to allow time to resolve any issues there may be.
Thank you!
Hayley M. Hatfield
Dearborn County Treasurer
TREASURER'S OFFICE
The office of the Dearborn County Treasurer is a constitutional office. The constitution of Indiana and Indiana statutory law provides for the election of a treasurer in each county. The treasurer is responsible for the collection of county property taxes and is the custodian for all money belonging to the county.
The treasurer is also responsible to invest the public funds in a manner which provides the highest investment return with maximum security.
The Treasurer is responsible for the mailing of the tax statements and for the collection and distribution of the taxes generated in Dearborn County. The treasurer also collects drainage assessments, excise tax and sewer liens.
Term: 4 years - elected - two term limit in 12 years.
Chief function of the Treasurer is to collect and retain custody of and disperse county funds.
Mails and collects property taxes
Collects excise taxes
Certifies Property Tax Clearance forms
Issues Moving Permits and Title Transfer Permits for Mobile Homes
For more information, please contact our office (contact information listed to the left).
